name: prompteye
description: See how a brand stands inside the answers AI assistants give — the prompts it is tracked on, the brands answering alongside it and the pages they cite.
long_description:
PromptEye tracks how often AI assistants name a brand when they answer buying questions. Pick a project — one brand tracked in one market — then work with the prompts it is tracked on, see which brands answer alongside it and which pages the assistants lean on.

Account, projects, prompts, prompt groups, categories, prompt suggestions, cited domains and competitors come from PromptEye. An API key and the API URL are required — both are at https://app.prompteye.com/integrations.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: The API URL of the deployment the key belongs to. Copy it from https://app.prompteye.com/integrations, next to the key.

api_key.title: PromptEye API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://app.prompteye.com/integrations. It starts with pe_live_ and needs the api_access scope.

prompts.name: visibility_review
prompts.description: Read the prompts, competitors and sources, and say what to fix first
prompts.text: Review how this brand stands inside AI answers. Gather list_prompts, list_competitors and list_sources, read them together, and finish with at most three things to do next.

prompts.name: what_to_track_next
prompts.description: Work through the suggestions and the gaps in the funnel
prompts.text: Decide which prompts this project should start tracking. Read the groups, the prompts and list_prompt_suggestions, and recommend the suggestions that close a missing funnel stage.

prompts.name: own_the_narrative
prompts.description: Turn the cited domains into where to publish, pitch or correct
prompts.text: Work out where this brand's story is being written. Read list_sources and list_competitors, sort the domains by the kind of work each needs, and name the ones worth acting on.

prompts.name: onboard_brand
prompts.description: Set up a new brand and get its first prompts in place
prompts.text: Set up PromptEye tracking for a brand in one market: check list_projects, create the project, read the brand description, then walk through the first prompt suggestions.
